15.learned: Three weeks ago, for no clear reason, I started stacking money — no plan, just a pull toward somewhere far off, maybe three clicks east of Russia, maybe Spain next year, I couldn't even tell you why. Then my brakes started grinding, that metal-cage sound that makes your stomach drop before anyone tells you the damage. And the stack I'd built for nothing in particular covered it exactly, like it was never really for nothing. ( ) must've already knew. Al-hamdulillah.
